Give talent the priority—not skin colour, caste, or regional background. Criticise the system, not individual actresses.

I have come up with this conclusion after watching KGF Chapter 2 once again and I made some serious observations in some particular scenes of this movie. I might be wrong in some parts too because this is just my point of view.

KGF team knows it well that there won't be any
excitement if the character itself is dead and people won't be interested in his past either. So, Rocky isn't dead here. He will survive! That's the reason the director gave us hints about Chapter 3 as well.Remember when Prakash Raj said that Rocky was about to execute his biggest plan? They never showed us what his biggest plan really was. Well let me tell you this was a part of his biggest plan.
Acting dead was a part of his biggest plan. And if you remember when rocky met Ramika Sen face to face he even says “I usually try to avoid wars, but If you really want it to happen I'll be the one who is going to win", and he was indeed right here. 
Why would he lose to her if he said this?
We already know that Rocky was not just a strong and powerful criminal he was very intelligent and clever too. He always thinks a step ahead of everyone. We even saw this in chapter 1 and chapter 2 as well. Have you ever wondered
 why he dug out all the gold from 9 mine sectors in just 2 years where as Suryavardhan took 25 years for the same. What was the reason for his urgency. So did he do all this to just go carry this in a ship and crash it, and lose all of this and die? Of course not. Yes this was exactly for the same plan he was about to execute. His aim is to get the world as he says in the part of this movie “world is my territory” He even wants to fulfill his mother's Promise of becoming very rich. It is obvious that he won't die after all of this. He is planning something really big in his mind and he is executing his biggest plan.
If you have watched this movie very carefully you would have seen in the climax when rocky is drivin his ship Prakash Raj says “He had most of the gold that anyone could have had in this world, and he is going to the perfect spot to hide all of it.”.
 Also when the Navy Captain and the Major were having a conversation, captain says him that “I don't think he is escaping with the gold, he's coming right towards us.” Why was he doing this on purpose? , He even says "Even the American and Indonesian ships arecoming for him" Why did he call them too?
This movie ends with so many un answered
questions...
• What was his actual plan?
• And did you ever wonder why did he go to indian
ocean where the Indian navy were? Why were the US Navy ships and Indonesian ships called by him?
So its clear he did all this wantedly.
• Why did he do all this wantedly?
• If he wanted to die without surrendering, why did he take all the gold with him?
•Why did he take that specific sea route only in
indian ocean?
•What happened to Inayat Khaleel next?
• His promise was to win the world and not just
india, when did he do that in chapter 2? They just showed Rocky drowning not dying.
So its almost clear that he is not dying but he is
executing his plan.
And if you remember the boy who was having a
conversation with Adheera while he was holding the burning bridge. If you would have observed carefully they don't show Adheera killing him. And when the dead bodies were bought to KGF his mother doesn't get to see the dead body's face either. So this kind of shows that the boy isn't dead yet and he is alive.
There's a new movie coming up called “Salaar”
which is starred by prabhas. This movie has the same director, Production house and producer, an the same music director as KGF Chapter 1 and 2. Even the boy's mother in KGF Chapter 2 is Prabas mother in Salaar. There were also hints given by the Movie makers that Salaar is connected with KGF. There's high chance he himself is prabhas and he is going to be rocky's army commader and rocky is going for his dream of taking over the world along with prabhas. Prashanth neel is a mastermind he is planning something really big to change the indian cinema. He wants KGF to become a verse just like
the Marvel and DC Movies. KGF is becoming a
verse!
- Likhith Kshatriya
